boldly.line: And cascading slowly, he lifted her wholly and boldly
stanza: And cascading slowly, he lifted her wholly and boldly
And despite people's derision proved to be more than diversion
And sha la la la la later on

boldly.line: I even wrote scenes where I reemerged boldly
stanza: I even wrote scenes where I reemerged boldly
New baby on my back, but from where?
